_comment_root: launch-strictdoc server configuration. The launcher has no menu; edit this file directly. See README for path placeholder syntax.
_comment_overview: All fields optional. project_path = the default offered at the prompt and the last-used project (auto-saved after each run); the actual folder is normally chosen by dragging it onto launch-strictdoc.bat. Defaults: host (127.0.0.1); port (5111 = START port for auto-assignment); open_browser (true); output_path (empty = <project>/output/strictdoc); color_mode (auto).
_comment_project_path: Optional. Default folder offered at the prompt and last-used project (auto-saved after each run, FR-1155). The actual folder is normally chosen by dragging it onto launch-strictdoc.bat (a file uses its parent folder). Path placeholders (replaced at first run / config init): USERNAME placeholder -> current Windows username; STARTER_ROOT placeholder -> the folder containing launch-strictdoc.bat. Bundled samples, in pairs that hold the same content in the two notations -- md- is written in Markdown, sd- in .sdoc/RST: samples/md-basic-ja and samples/sd-basic-ja (the basics; copy one of these to start your own spec), samples/md-basic-en and samples/sd-basic-en (the same in English; md-basic-en is the current default), samples/md-sovd-automotive-ja (a full SOVD vehicle-diagnostics spec) and samples/md-sovd-automotive-en.
_comment_host: Server bind host. Allowed: IPv4 dotted-decimal (e.g. 127.0.0.1, 0.0.0.0), 'localhost', or IPv6 literal (e.g. ::, ::1). 127.0.0.1 = local only (recommended). 0.0.0.0 and :: = LAN exposed (browser open auto-translates to 127.0.0.1).
_comment_port: Server START port (1024..65535). Default 5111 = strictdoc default. Multiple documents opened at once auto-get the next free port (5112, 5113, ... up to start+20) -- no need to change this (FR-1156).
_comment_open_browser: Auto-open default browser to http://host:port/ after Start succeeds. true|false.
_comment_output_path: strictdoc --output-path. Leave empty for <project folder>/output/strictdoc, which is what you normally want: each project then keeps its own generated HTML instead of sharing one folder with every other project (FR-1160). The first level has to stay named 'output' -- strictdoc skips a folder of that name when looking for documents, and any other name makes the second run read back its own output. Same path placeholders as project_path (USERNAME, STARTER_ROOT) supported.
_comment_color_mode: Appearance of the generated pages: auto|light|dark. auto follows the Windows light/dark setting. Change it with change-color-mode.bat rather than by hand; a project picks up the new value the next time you open it. StrictDoc has no dark mode of its own, so this works by adding a stylesheet on top of it: the text goes dark, but a few small controls are only partly covered and source code highlighting is unchanged (FR-1162).
_comment_config_upgrade_declined: Written by the launcher, not by you. Remembers which projects said no when offered an update to their strictdoc_config.py, so the question is asked once per project per version instead of on every launch (FR-1163). Delete an entry to be asked again.
